Opening hours

Tickets currently can be booked 6 months in advance, please note that opening times may vary slightly. 

On October 23 the bath will be open from 8 am to 22 pm, the DaysPalm will be open until 2 pm.
On 30 October the Dayspalm is open until 5 pm.

The bath is open from 8 am on holidays and peak season (October 23-25, 2025, December 18, 2026 - January 6, 2027).
On December 25, 2026 and January 1, 2027 the bath is open until 8 pm.
